responsibility: Provides the Xtensa bare-metal ELF subtarget configuration for the driver and preprocessor/assembler/linker interface. It overrides core target macros for data model details, assembler and linker specs, startup and end files, library defaults, local-label syntax, PIC policy, and host-side search paths for arch-specific headers and libraries, thereby defining how the generic Xtensa backend is packaged for non-Linux ELF toolchains and simulators.
same_name_distinction: Pairs with elf.opt as the macro/spec header for the bare-metal ELF subtarget: it defines assembler, linker, startup/library, type, label, PIC, and host search-path behavior, whereas elf.opt only declares the driver option names consumed by those specs (notably rdynamic).
